main.description: An immutable collection of release artifacts. Written once and never updated: all facts (artifact digests, sizes, locations) are fixed at creation. Lifecycle changes use software.release.status records and software.release.channel moves. Any update to an existing release record is treated by indexers as a probable-compromise signal. Valid only when this record's DID matches the referenced project's DID.

project.description: The software.release.project this release belongs to. Must be same-DID.

artifacts.description: Typed release artifact fragments. Distribution and integrity rules are specified by each artifact's schema.
